name: qkd_seq-kc5-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 track B: the merged-die KV sequencer on the contract slot `seq` as a wires-only cluster parent over nine hardened leaves (qkd_seq_core, 4 x qkd_seq_xs, 4 x qkd_seq_fan; each <= 15k sinks on its own root, every pin a register). No parent cell, no parent flop. See slot_change_request (pin list, outline 604.8 x 475.2, cluster layers).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_seq u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_kv_centre_slots.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_kv_seq_merged.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo.sv rtl/qwen_sys/system_20261008/ot_qfd_dctl.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_kv_desc.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/qwen_sys/ot_qwen_sys_rst_seq.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: seq_equiv_exact
bench.note: cluster qkd_seq (wires-only parent + core + 4 xs + 4 fan) == flat ot_qkvd_kv_seq_merged on every output bit of every cycle: 96,336 cycles, 160 layers (kvd launches), 49 decode steps through the stage stepper against a ROM-sequencer model (stage order, token / position, result checked) + one step per stepper fault kind, host program / descriptor writes checked on both copies, credit-true traffic on every bundle, every output bit seen at 0 and 1, per-quadrant row-credit protocol checked

bench.name: seq_equiv_wire_mutant
bench.note: OT_QKD_SEQ_MUT: the parent swaps two store slices on the E copies of the q word

bench.name: seq_equiv_coverage_refusal
bench.note: a run of 8 layers is refused: the pass needs the traffic counts and full toggle coverage

bench.name: layer_cluster_exact
bench.note: the KV-end attention layer step as a whole decode step through the CLUSTER (Verilator, STACK=h): 7 vectors x VM stall 0 / 1 = 14 runs, all bit-exact against the golden; step 1,794 cycles at context 8192 (two-die 1,842); measured 10-13 on ot-agidock128

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters
